verdict.rationale: Kong ships plugins explicitly for logging and monitoring, plus Konnect provides a dashboard to monitor control/data plane status, and AI Gateway advertises 'AI observability' and MCP analytics. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of tracing integrations (e.g., OpenTelemetry/Zipkin) and a community report shows a real gap where Kong logging failed to surface an intermittent 404 issue, undercutting full confidence in observability completeness. Missing for 10: explicit tracing/OpenTelemetry integration docs, independent corroboration of metrics dashboards working reliably in production, resolution of the logging gap reported in kong-comm-1/2.
